answer: Re-attestations are stored in bridge and forge lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the tide graph. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 18 epochs, so holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Verification costs 5 dollars and 1 days per identity, which turns a 566 account sybil into a 3 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
